March 10, 2026

# Northwind joins shared branching network

PORTSMITH—Through the shared branching network, Northwind members have access to more than 5,000 participating branches nationwide.

Northwind Community Credit Union is a member-owned financial cooperative. It has 14 branch office locations and 320 employees.
